notes_sections.heading: Methodology correction — this run replaces an earlier same-day pass
items: An earlier 2026-09-21 run used WebFetch (anonymous HTML fetch + summarization) against Dice's search URLs and reported 22 "unique" postings including 5 that turned out to be wrong: Kforce Technology Staffing's Forward Deployed Engineer (Armonk, NY), High Bridge Consulting's Senior AI FDE, Cencora's FDE, a Kanshe Infotech Salesforce Financial Services Cloud Architect, and TechniPros' Principal Generative AI Engineer.

This browser-based re-run, done logged in as Marc's actual Dice account, confirms those 5 were never real search-result hits — they were entries from the "Similar Jobs" sidebar shown on a job-detail page, which WebFetch's markdown conversion flattened into the same list as genuine search results. Dice's own on-page result counters (e.g. "1 results (0 new)" for Forward Deployed Engineer) confirm the true, much smaller result sets used here.

Current rendered counts remain DevOps Engineer 4, Platform Engineer 10, Site Reliability Engineer 0, Cloud Engineer 5, DevSecOps Engineer 3, and Forward Deployed Engineer 1. The merged skill reviews at most eight results per query, yielding 17 unique inspected IDs after cross-query deduplication.
Kforce remains a real posting but appeared only in Dice's Similar Jobs module, not in an audited filtered result list. It is therefore excluded from current query totals and report rows.
